title: GPU unused: the runner installs tensorflow-cpu over Colab's CUDA build
where: requirements-ci.txt:13 (tensorflow-cpu~=2.21.0); tools/colab_runner.py install step; tools/profile_run.py install_cuda_tensorflow
evidence_detail: gpu-diag-001: tensorflow and tensorflow_cpu both installed, the CPU files win, TF sees no GPU on a T4 runtime; profile-001 trained 42810 steps/epoch at ~30 min/epoch on CPU. install_cuda_tensorflow fixes it per job for ~2 min
fix_idea: runner job key gpu:true that skips tensorflow-cpu and records tf.config GPUs in env.json (M0); until then profile_run.install_cuda_tensorflow + require_gpu

title: uncertainty_error_corr = 0.38
evidence_detail: profile-003: 0.3805 pooled over 685208 rows. Suspected to be a price-scale effect between coins (a coin with a large price has a large absolute error and a large uncertainty in price units), not information inside a coin; tools/signal_diagnostics.py gives the within-asset Spearman and a within-asset permutation null to separate the two
fix_idea: read the within-asset number of profile-005; if it is near 0 the 0.38 is the cross-asset scale, and the metric should be computed in return units / within asset
